ClientResponses.Response: Hello, thank you for taking the time to share your feedback! We are very sorry to learn about the disappointment with the ash catcher. It would be best if you did not have to do this to remove your ash catcher. We suggest using heat-resistant gloves, squeezing the handle, and detaching it from the bottom of the bowl. Once cleaned, you can re-attach it to the bottom of the bowl. Please, if you continue to experience this issue, contact us. We would love to discuss this further. Thanks!

ClientResponses.Response:
Thanks for your feedback. We are sorry to hear that your grill did not meet your expectations. We list all of the features included with our grills on the website as well as the packaging to prevent confusion. The Original Kettle® Premium charcoal grill boasts upgraded features, such as a hinged cooking grate for easily adding charcoal while grilling, and the One-Touch™ cleaning system with high-capacity ash catcher, making for a smooth grilling experience from beginning to end. 

We recommend our Master-Touch grill if you are looking for a Weber charcoal grill with a Tuck-Away™  lid holder and Char-Basket™ fuel holders. 

We appreciate your feedback about being able to move the cooking grate and we'll definitely bring it to our team. For now, the best way to control temperature on your charcoal kettle is through the position of your lid and bowl dampers. 

Like every Weber, your grill is backed with a generous warranty. Please reach out to our Support team if there is ever anything we can do to help! Happy grilling!

Results.ReviewText:
Great small charcoal grill for those who like the charcoal grilling method.  Being the grill is titled "premium" I would have liked to see it come with a charcoal box to segment the charcoal easier/ quicker.

Also the lid has a small "lip" on it for hanging it on the main bottom portion of the grill tub is a cheap and a nuisance at times.  I have seen some kettle charcoal grills that actually have a mounting mechanism that you can put the lid in for "holding" as you are tending to the grilling items on the grates.  This would be much easier.  Again as a "premium" I would have thought that feature would come with the grill I purchased.  

Finally, would like to have better temp control such as the ability to raise and lower the cooking grate.
Results.Title: Grillin' in NC

Results.ReviewText: Great grill!  Always best quality from Weber.  I love the ash collection pan; so easy to clean up!  Only negative things is, for some odd unexplained reason, Weber decided to remove the kettle handle on the wheel side.  Now you can't lift the grill with two hands to move it; you can only wheel it around.   Not sure what the logic was for that change.  Was it a safety concern or something?  Very disappointing change to what otherwise is a perfect grill.

Also I am used to cooking one or two (separately) turkeys at Thanksgiving time so the pair of charcoal holding bins will come in handy for the indirect heating method.  I'm very happy with my upgraded set up.

14401001.Name: 22” Original Kettle® Premium Charcoal Grill
14401001.Description: Some things never go out of style—like the smoky flavor of charcoal, the sizzle of a summer cookout, and the iconic silhouette of the 22" Original Kettle® Premium Charcoal Grill. This grill features a built-in lid thermometer to monitor the temperature inside the grill, and a hinged, plated-steel cooking grate flips up on either side allowing you to easily add more fuel while cooking. Like all Weber® kettles, it’s built to last with a porcelain-enameled bowl and lid that retains heat and resist rust, peeling, and scratching, and adjustable lid and bowl dampers to fine-tune the heat for perfect results. When it’s time to clean up, the One-Touch™ cleaning system makes it neat and effortless—just swipe the lever to clear ashes into the enclosed, high-capacity ash catcher. Two wheels make it easy to roll this timeless classic to the center of the action, right where it belongs. Because some grills don’t just cook food, they make memories.· Porcelain-enameled finish is scratch and rust-resistant· Room to cook for 6-8 people· Hinged, plated-steel cooking grate· Lid thermometer makes it easy to see grill temperature· Adjustable lid and bowl dampers let you control temperature· Lid hook to hang lid on bowl while cooking· 2 tool hooks included on bowl handle· One-Touch™ cleaning system sweeps ash into enclosed catcher· Easy to move on two durable, all-weather wheels· Heat-resistant lid and bowl handles· Bottom, wire storage shelf· Durable fuel grate· 3 aluminum legs are rust-resistant· 10-year limited warranty
